responsibility: Implements the Rust front end’s cfg-based stripping pass over the expanded AST. This file evaluates #[cfg] predicates against Session state, expands #[cfg_attr] into concrete attributes, walks crates and nested AST nodes with CfgStrip, marks or erases items, fields, parameters, statements, and other attribute-bearing nodes that should be removed, and emits diagnostics when cfg-driven stripping would invalidate required syntax positions such as types, patterns, or mandatory expressions.
same_name_distinction: Defines the cfg-stripping pass’s executable behavior: it evaluates cfg predicates, expands cfg_attr, walks concrete AST nodes, erases stripped children, and diagnoses illegal removals. Unlike the paired header, this .cc contains the pass logic rather than the CfgStrip interface and visitor declarations.
